The landing is `references/platform-readings.md` (314/314, additions frozen into corpus audit #13597) ⇒ same disposition as the rest of the family. Note carried for the post-restart flight: the cheapest honest shape may be LINE-NEUTRAL — widening the existing inline-code read-drop row to cover standalone HTML-comment lines plus the both-channels-before-attributing rule — which would make it the correction-carve-out class rather than an addition; measure, don't assume.

Restart-when: closed #13597

Operationally live from this card meanwhile: a marker missing from an MCP comment read is NOT evidence of a write-side strip; the decisive read is the zero-quota payload, and both channels must be read before attributing loss to either side.
